title: Hollywood studio New Line to remake Italy's Oscar entry The Spiral
summary: The studio will also release the original Italian film in US cinemas before the end of the year.
body:
New Line Cinema has won the rights to make an English-language version of The Spiral, the psychological horror film that Italy has entered for this year's Oscars.

The studio beat rival bidders for the rights, Deadline reported. The deal also lets New Line release the original film in the United States and several other countries, and it plans a limited US cinema release before the end of the year.

About the film

The Spiral was written and directed by Paolo Strippoli. Jasmine Trinca plays a mother whose family life is thrown into turmoil when a mysterious woman, played by Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, draws her into a dangerous pact.

No director or cast has been announced for the remake.

Sources: Deadline, Bloody Disgusting.
